notes: Shock and awe now waits for your order: plan strike boxes and assign assets, then press Begin shock and awe on the ✸ Fires rail. Launch the ground war whenever you are ready (day 30 at the latest, or push it back)
Every strike box can hold, keep up sustained fire, or fire a single salvo on demand, before or after G-Day. The daily cost of sustained fire is shown per box

Softening now matters: assaulting intact, dug-in Republican Guard positions costs about twice the casualties, and badly hit units fall back. Fully softened positions cut losses to about 0.6×. Assault planning shows the expected loss multiplier
